الاضافات 
التالية التى تتم :
- الوقود "مازوت" لتقليل التأكل الكيميائى على اسطح التسخين وتحسين كفاءة الاحتراق 
- هيدرازين ... للتخلص من 
"O2" 
ويتم حقنة فى الـ 
LP Drum
لتقليل التأكل الكيميائى وتحسين الكفاءة
- الامونيا للتخلص من 
Co2 وتحقن عند خط طرد طلمبات المتكاثف حيث تغذية الغلاية لتقليل التأكل الكيميائى وتحسين الكفاءة
- الفوسفات للتخلص من املاح العسرفي الـHP Drum

ضبط 
الرقم الهيدروجينى لمياه تغذية الغلاية
فى مياه التغذية PH control "8.59.5"a

اضافة 
سلفات الصوديوم لطرد "O2"
الذائب وضبط "PH" 
فى مياه التغذية للغلاية
مياه التغذية يجب ان لا تحتوى على اكثر من خمسة جزء فى البليون 
O2 
ذائب

مواد 
الاضاقات للتحكم فى ترسب شوائب الحديد
تتم الاضافة لمياه تغذية الغلاية

مدى 
وجود 
Co2 وشوائب النحاس فى مياه التغذية
طبقا لضغط الغلاية يجبان تكون هذه المواد فى مياه الغلاية

نظام 
تفوير مياه الغلاية لضبط الـ PH
اقل ما يمكن "... جزء فى البليون"

نظام 
ازالة الرماد والاتربة من على اسطح التسخين وتبادل الحرارة فى الغلاية
Soot blowers, for asr & dust 
Removal systems in boiler

نظام 
المرسبات الكهربية ونزع الكبريت من الغازات الساخنة وازالة الاتربة
Electrostatic precipitators & flue 
gases desul pherizers, dust disposal

- طلمبات المتكاثف والتغذية والتدوير والوقود ... الخ
- 
بلوف الامان والبخار والمياه ... الخ

Burners

لدورات "البخار + الماء + الوقود"

انظمة

نظام

جودة

rows: This form was prepared by the Maintenance Procedures Development and Quality Control Sector of the Holding Company, with the agreement of the MPIS coordinators on [date not stated in source], for the purpose of quality control of boiler maintenance at power stations of the electricity generation companies
Actual boiler capacity in "tonnes of steam/hour", compared with the design capacity
Actual boiler pressure, compared with the design pressure
Superheated steam temperature, compared with the design value
Actual fuel consumption rate "g/kWh", compared with the design value
Boiler operation on the different fuel systems — natural gas, mazout, hot gases
Results of radiographic imaging of the boiler for crack detection
Results of fuel sample analysis "natural gas, mazout" — Notes: sulphur levels in the fuel
Results of hot gas sample analysis at the stack inlet — Notes: extent of SOx, NOx and CO gases present

Results of water and steam sample analysis from the following locations: - Boiler feedwater pump discharge line - Water from the HP Drum - Water from the condensate pump discharge line - Steam from the HP Drum — sodium present .. ppb .. silica, calcium, magnesium - Steam from the superheater (SH Steam)

The following additives applied: - Fuel "mazout" to reduce chemical corrosion on heating surfaces and improve combustion efficiency - Hydrazine ... to remove "O2", injected into the LP Drum to reduce chemical corrosion and improve efficiency - Ammonia to remove CO2, injected at the condensate pump discharge line at the boiler feed point to reduce chemical corrosion and improve efficiency - Phosphate to remove hardness salts in the HP Drum
pH control of boiler feedwater — PH control "8.59.5"
Addition of sodium sulphate to expel dissolved "O2" and control "pH" in boiler feedwater — feedwater must not contain more than five ppb of dissolved O2
Additives to control the deposition of iron impurities, added to boiler feedwater
Extent of CO2 and copper impurities in feedwater; depending on boiler pressure, these substances must be present in the boiler water
Boiler water blowdown system to control pH to the lowest possible value "... ppb"
System for removing ash and dust from the heating and heat exchange surfaces in the boiler — Soot blowers, for ash & dust removal systems in boiler
Electrostatic precipitators and flue gas desulphurisation and dust removal system — Electrostatic precipitators & flue gases desulphurizers, dust disposal
Pumps and valves — condensate, feedwater, circulation and fuel pumps ... etc. — safety, steam and water valves ... etc.
Burners and the fuel ignition control system — Burners
Boiler control, protection and metering systems for the "steam + water + fuel" circuits
Demineralisation and air removal systems ... from feedwater
Early fire detection alarm system — fire fighting system
Quality of the boiler connection to the station general earthing network
Components of the fuel and air circuit in the boiler
Components of the water circuit in the boiler
Components of the steam circuit in the boiler
